description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for different linguistic “tag” categories across multiple model configurations. The horizontal axis represents the categories – “case”, “gender”, “tag”, “number”, and “tense” – listed in that order, and is labeled “tag”. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals.  There are four sets of bars for each category, representing the models mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), and XLM-R2 (dark red). Each set of bars includes a vertical line indicating a standard deviation. For the “case” category, the mBERT-L2 bar is approximately 6 units tall, while the XLM-R2 bar is approximately 17 units tall.  For the “gender” category, the bars range from approximately 1 unit (mBERT-R2) to approximately 8 units (XLM-L2). The “tag”, “number”, and “tense” categories show bars with heights generally between 1 and 7 units across all models. The bars are grouped by category, with each model represented by a distinct color within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
